'''Alexandru Zaharescu''' (born June 4, 1961) is a [[Romania]]n [[mathematician]]. He is a professor in the Department of Mathematics,<ref>{{cite web|url=https://math.illinois.edu|title= Department of Mathematics}}</ref> [[University of Illinois at Urbana–Champaign]], and an Honorary Member<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.imar.ro/en/people/honorary-members|title= Honorary members of the Simion Stoilow Institute of Mathematics of the Romanian Academy|website=www.imar.ro|access-date=September 5, 2026}}</ref> at the [[Institute of Mathematics of the Romanian Academy]]. He has two PhDs in mathematics, one from the [[University of Bucharest]] in 1991 under the direction of [[Nicolae Popescu]], the other from [[Princeton University]] in 1995 under the direction of [[Peter Sarnak]]. Zaharescu made numerous contributions to number theory. In total, he has more than 350 publications.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://math.illinois.edu/directory/profile/zaharesc|title= Alexandru Zaharescu CV and some Publications}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://experts.illinois.edu/en/persons/alexandru-zaharescu |title=Alexandru Zaharescu full list of publications}}</ref>

==Early life==
Zaharescu was born on June 4, 1961, and grew up in [[Codlea]], Romania. He graduated from high school in Codlea in 1980, and from the [[University of Bucharest]] in 1986. He joined the [[Institute of Mathematics of the Romanian Academy]] in 1989, and in 1991 he received a PhD from the University of Bucharest.

==Career==
Zaharescu received his second PhD from Princeton University in 1995. After that, he held temporary positions at the [[Massachusetts Institute of Technology]],  [[McGill University]], the [[Institute for Advanced Study]], before joining the faculty at the University of Illinois in 2000.

==Awards and honours==
Zaharescu was elected a Fellow of the [[American Mathematical Society]] in 2017, for contributions to analytic number theory.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.ams.org/profession/ams-fellows/rnoti-p268.pdf|title= 2017 Class of Fellows of the AMS}}</ref> A conference in honor of his 60th birthday was held in June 2021 at the Institute of Mathematics of the Romanian Academy.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://imar.ro/~apopa/BNTD9.html|title=Ninth Bucharest Number Theory Days. June 1–3, 2021. In honor of Alexandru Zaharescu's 60th Birthday|website=imar.ro|publisher=[[Institute of Mathematics of the Romanian Academy]]|access-date=May 9, 2021}}</ref> In March 2024, he was elected Honorary Member of the Romanian Academy.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://acad.ro/institutia/sectia_3.html|title=Secția de științe matematice|language=ro|website=acad.ro|publisher=[[Romanian Academy]]|access-date=September 5, 2026}}</ref>
